name: lumemex
description: Personal knowledge base system using the LLM Wiki pattern.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @lumemex/shared && npm run build --workspace @lumemex/core && npm run build --workspace @lumemex/cli && npm run build --workspace @lumemex/web
scripts.cli: npm run build --workspace @lumemex/shared && npm run build --workspace @lumemex/core && npm run build --workspace @lumemex/cli && npm --workspace @lumemex/cli run start --
